name: Hamamatsu_S13360-3050CS
_comment: Reference SiPM for GCAM thermal/gain simulations. Datasheet-derived; the classic scintillation MPPC (well-documented temperature behaviour). Green-scintillator (GAGG ~520 nm) coupling.

_stabilizationModel._biasCompNote: ① temperature-compensated bias: tracks vbr(T); residual from finite dV_br/dT accuracy + T-sense error
_stabilizationModel._ledNote: ② LED reference pulser: locks SiPM+electronics optical gain; does NOT see crystal light yield (LED bypasses the crystal)
_stabilizationModel._crystalNote: GAGG:Ce,Mg light-yield drift — only a spectral reference (K-40 / reference source, method ③) catches this; ①/② cannot
